title: Chapter 25 Ouyang Yanqing Breaks Through
content:
Chapter 25 Ouyang Yanqing Breaks Through

At this time, in a room on the top floor of Baihua Tower.

Mu Tianyin woke up from the hot bed, as if she felt something, and then fanned Ji Shengcai who was sleeping beside her to wake him up.

"Get up, go see what's going on."

Ji Shengcai woke up in a daze and hugged Mu Tianyin in his arms.

"Oh, don't worry about it, wife, they are just some small people. I have already established a good relationship with the City Lord's Mansion. Just sleep peacefully."

Hearing this, Mu Tianyin rolled her eyes.

That's right, five hundred years have passed, and the two are already together.

And a few hundred years ago, the two were still competitors.

Mu Tianyin started a teahouse business in the deserted city.

However, people actually ran to Baihua Tower, making Mu Tianyin's place scarce.

This made Mu Tianyin a little angry, and then he went to find Ji Shengcai to argue.

After a while, Ji Shengcai actually fell in love with this big sister.

Then he began to pursue her madly.

At first, Mu Tianyin looked down on Ji Shengcai's way of making a fortune, but she didn't expect that Ji Shengcai's business was so popular that Ji Shengcai made a lot of money.

In the end, Ji Shengcai spent money to win Mu Tianyin.

She, Mu Tianyin, really didn't love money, but everything that touched Mu Tianyin cost money.

At that time, countless people in the deserted city sighed.

......

The inner city of the deserted city.

It's not as lively as the outer city, but there are many more people than five hundred years ago.

Many of the original inhabitants of the deserted city even have great-grandchildren.

According to the words of the city lord Lu Daosheng, it will always be good if you have more branches and leaves.

As for getting married and having children, it's too simple.

As soon as the news was released, women who wanted to marry into the inner city or men who wanted to marry into the inner city lined up from the deserted city to the end of the Tianxuan world.

There was no way, the conditions for living in the deserted city were too harsh.

So far, except for the natives of the deserted city, no one in the inner city has actually moved in.

"Old Zhang, I heard that your new baby was born with the five elements, congratulations."

"Hahaha, your baby is not bad either, it caused a strange phenomenon in the world as soon as it was born."

Old Zhang and Old Li smiled as soon as they met.

It can be said that they were having a great time.

There is no doubt that the Zhang family and the Li family can now be called big families.

And they are big families in the inner city of the deserted city.

......

Inside the city lord's mansion.

In a mysterious space, Lu Daosheng slowly opened his eyes and then breathed a sigh of relief.

Now, he has read all the books collected by the system for him.

The whole world view is also completely clear.

The universe deep inside him is called the Hongmeng Universe, which is divided into countless galaxies.

Some galaxies are very powerful, and the strongest among them even have the existence of the unknown realm. Such galaxies are called first-level galaxies.

Some galaxies are weaker, and the strongest are only in the ancient realm, which is lower than the first-level galaxy, so they are called second-level galaxies.

The rest are arranged in order.

The galaxy where the Tianxuan world is located is called the Xuan Gu galaxy, which is the lowest level of the fourth-level galaxy.

The highest realm is only the existence of the Emperor of Heaven.

Of course, that was only in the past.

Now, the Xuan Gu galaxy where he is located can be called the legendary top galaxy.

There are still existences above the unknown realm.

However, Lu Daosheng has not been out for these years, and Lu Daosheng has also deduced that he found that the Xuan Gu galaxy seemed to have an extremely glorious history a long, long time ago.

It's just that that history was erased from the long river of time and space by some existences.

Lu Daosheng slowly stood up, then took a step out and came directly to the City Lord's Mansion.

At the same time, under a sacred tree, Ouyang Yanqing's aura suddenly surged, and the sound of the Great Dao echoed all over his body.

Instantly, the whole deserted city noticed this movement.

However, everyone seemed to be accustomed to this phenomenon, and they did what they should do.

Rumble!

At this time, the sky began to tear apart.

If it weren't for these sacred objects in the deserted city lord's mansion in recent years, not only did they benefit the practitioners, but also promoted the entire Tianxuan world.

Otherwise, this movement alone would probably be enough to destroy the entire Tianxuan world.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng understood that Ouyang Yanqing was about to break through.

And the next realm is the cause and effect realm.

On the side, Gu Chen and Lu Xue appeared beside Lu Daosheng.

"Dad."

"City Lord."

Looking at the two, Lu Daosheng smiled.

At this time, Lu Xue had reached the realm of the Heavenly Emperor.

And Gu Chen also made great progress.

The higher the realm, the more difficult it is to break through, and the longer it takes.

Ouyang Yanqing can break through to the realm of cause and effect at this moment, not only because of the five hundred years of practice, but also because of the accumulation of endless years.

On the wall of Huangcheng.

Huang Shou is in a special space.

This is where Lu Daosheng specially prepared for Huang Shou.

Here, the environment he is in is the same as that in the City Lord's Mansion, and he can also enjoy the effects of those divine objects.

"Oh, too slow."

At this time, Huang Shou had already reached the realm of cause and effect.

Facing Ouyang Yanqing's breakthrough, Huang Shou only had ridicule in his eyes.

Behind him was the Lord of Huangcheng.

Now he often feels lucky that he met Lu Daosheng and joined the Wasteland City.

Otherwise, how could he live so comfortably now.

Boom!

Another loud noise.

The whole sky suddenly changed color, and countless streams of light continued to fall from the starry sky.

Some streams of light entered the body of the cultivator, and suddenly, he had an epiphany on the spot.

Seeing this scene, everyone exclaimed.

Thank you for the gift of nature!

However, this is not over yet. In the City Lord's Mansion, several sacred trees trembled under the authorization of Lu Daosheng.

For a while, it rained heavily in the Wasteland City.

And this rain is not real rain, but the essence of several sacred trees.

Once absorbed, it will benefit you endlessly.

Suddenly, the people of the whole Wasteland City cheered and kept calling the City Lord.

After an unknown period of time, the movement finally slowly dissipated.

Under the ancient tree of enlightenment, Ouyang Yanqing opened her eyes and felt the power in her body. Ouyang Yanqing couldn't help laughing.

"Miss Ouyang."

At this time, Lu Daosheng's voice sounded.

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing was stunned. The next moment, Ouyang Yanqing appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Still wearing that bright red dress.

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Ouyang Yanqing felt a little complicated. Now, she has become stronger.

And she also felt Lu Daosheng's terror more clearly.

"Thank you."

Ouyang Yanqing thanked him seriously.

"If there are any difficulties in the deserted city in the future, I will definitely help you."

She had nothing to repay Lu Daosheng, after all, Lu Daosheng seemed to have everything.

So she could only do this.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's face lit up.

"Are you leaving?"

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing smiled slightly.

"Of course not, I don't have anything to do there, so I'll stay here for a few more days."

"You won't mind, right?"

Ouyang Yanqing playfully winked at Lu Daosheng a few times.

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng looked a little embarrassed.

"Ahaha, of course I don't mind."

At this time, Lu Xue came over from a distance.

Seeing Lu Xue, Ouyang Yanqing's face lit up, and she quickly came to Lu Xue and held Lu Xue's hand.

"Xiaoxue's cultivation is increasing so fast again, let's go, sister will take you out to play."

Hearing this, Lu Xue hesitated a little, then turned her head to look at Lu Daosheng.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng smiled helplessly, "Go, be careful."

"Hehe, thank you, Dad."

Then, Ouyang Yanqing took Lu Xue away.

Originally, Lu Xue was a little hostile to Ouyang Yanqing at the beginning.

But later, in order to stay here shamelessly, Ouyang Yanqing kept trying to win over Lu Xue.

How could Lu Xue, a young girl who had not experienced much of the world, deal with Ouyang Yanqing? Not long after, Lu Xue was completely dominated by Ouyang Yanqing.

This made Lu Daosheng somewhat helpless.

But he had no choice, because Ouyang Yanqing had no ill will towards his daughter, and was really kind.

Then Lu Daosheng turned a blind eye to Ouyang Yanqing.
